title: gcd is commutative on the integers
statement: For all integers a and b, gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a). (The integer gcd returns a natural number.)

formal.statement: theorem Int.gcd_comm : ((x0 : Int) -> ((x1 : Int) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (Int.gcd x0 x1) (Int.gcd x1 x0)))

evidence.supports: For all integers a and b, gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a). (The integer gcd returns a natural number.)
